$comment: Official sources GOV View checks. Add a source by opening a pull request: give it an id, the connector that reads it, and its licence or terms. Only official sources (government bodies, public service commissions, regulators, gazettes) belong here.

robotsException.reason: The weekly CSV is an official open-data file published under Licence Ouverte 2.0 for reuse, linked from the data.gouv.fr API. robots.txt on the file host targets crawlers indexing pages; we download one file per run at most, at 1 request/second, identifying ourselves.
